name: Open Interpreter
description: A natural-language interface to a local code interpreter that runs Python, shell, AppleScript, and JS on the user's machine.
notes: Open Interpreter is one of the most capability-rich agents in the catalog — `--auto_run` skips the per-command confirmation prompt, which is appropriate inside the sandbox but would be reckless on a real host. The audio I/O surface is disabled at the container level (no /dev/snd, no PulseAudio socket).
